eligibility.opening_range: maximum high minus minimum low over the opening window
eligibility.compression_reference: median opening range of the previous 60 eligible sessions, shifted one session
eligibility.compression_rule: current opening range is strictly below the shifted reference median

entry.acceptance_windows: non-overlapping five-minute windows aligned from 10:00 ET
entry.long_acceptance: the completed five-minute close is strictly above the opening-range high
entry.short_acceptance: the completed five-minute close is strictly below the opening-range low
entry.fill: following one-minute open plus one adverse tick for longs or minus one adverse tick for shorts

exit.stop_fill: midpoint plus one adverse tick; a gap beyond the stop uses the worse bar open plus one adverse tick
exit.same_bar_policy: if the entry bar can touch the midpoint stop, assume the stop fills
exit.survivor_exit: 15:30 one-minute open plus one adverse tick
